narrative:
## Handover Summary — Overheads & Cost-Out

Overheads validated across five cost centers and six legal entities.

## Key Decisions
• Simplification savings phased: GBP 8M actioned, GBP 32M to land by end-2027
• Technology and AI platform spend held, with legacy platform decommissioning funding the Snowflake and AWS run cost
• Group functions held flat in real terms

## Recommendation for CapEx
Confirm Synergy Business Process Services mobilisation spend before locking the AI platform programme.

signals.title: £40m simplification savings — £8m actioned
signals.excerpt: After the private sector contact centre disposal, actions taken by 30 June deliver £8m of annualised savings against a £40m target by end-2027, with about £20m cost to achieve.
